title: C++: Classes & Objects
description: Define a class representing a Rectangle with width, height, area() method, and a constructor.

steps.title: Rectangle Class
steps.description: Define a `Rectangle` class with private double width, height, a constructor that takes both, and a method `double area()` that returns w*h. Create a Rectangle(5.0, 3.0) and print its area.
hints: class Rectangle { private: double w, h; public: Rectangle(double w, double h); double area(); };
Constructor: Rectangle::Rectangle(double w, double h) : w(w), h(h) {}

verification.failureMessage: Create a Rectangle(5,3) and print its area
